expected.subject: Recurring on Growth?
expected.body: There's no 'Make recurring' option under More. Why?

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

The 'Make recurring' option only appears on the Pro plan, so it won't show under More on Growth.

To get recurring invoices:
1. Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan and choose Pro (R699/month).
2. The upgrade takes effect immediately, and you're charged a pro-rated amount for the rest of the current month.
3. Open any invoice and click More > Make recurring, then choose the frequency and start date.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Kettle can't reverse client payments. We don't hold your money, so refunds to your clients are done in your payment provider's dashboard.

To refund the R3,000:
1. Log in to your PayFast dashboard.
2. Find the payment from your client.
3. Issue the refund from there.
